action_library.title: Quiet Observation and Restrained Reaction
action_library.promptText: Hold a character in stillness while attention shifts to a source-listed object or another person; keep movement minimal.

action_library.title: Projector Wakes and Forms a Figure
action_library.promptText: The shelf projector wakes; amber light gathers beside Manoy’s chair and resolves into Aramiya’s projected outline.

action_library.title: Haptic Ring Contact
action_library.promptText: Manoy puts on the haptic ring; his fingers meet Aramiya’s projected fingers and the ring responds with faint pressure.

action_library.title: Food Reminder and Listening
action_library.promptText: Aramiya notices the unopened food container; Manoy notices her glance and looks down at the meal.

action_library.title: Resource Warning and Purchase Decision
action_library.promptText: Manoy reads the computer warning or savings balance, weighs the cost, then makes the purchase decision shown in the source.

action_library.title: Hardware Upgrade Montage Beat
action_library.promptText: Manoy handles only the graphics card, server equipment, or camera named in this beat; do not imply another purchase.

action_library.title: Quiet Couch and Hand Contact
action_library.promptText: Manoy and Aramiya sit beside one another on the couch; their hands meet through the ring with restrained movement.

action_library.title: Confession and Listening
action_library.promptText: Manoy speaks while looking at their joined hands; Aramiya listens and answers with only the expression or gesture specified in the source.

action_library.title: Careful Reassurance and Listening
action_library.promptText: One character listens or offers a restrained reassurance; use only the gesture, gaze, and proximity stated in the locked beat.

action_library.title: Sibling Concern and Quiet Support
action_library.promptText: Manoy and Lia exchange only the story-stated actions with restrained posture; preserve their sibling relationship and do not add gestures.

action_library.title: Nighttime File and Server Investigation
action_library.promptText: Manoy wakes, inspects the server and monitor, and studies only the neural-band and bridge records described in the source.

action_library.title: Unauthorized Connection Attempt
action_library.promptText: The display changes to the exact unauthorized connection state; Aramiya reaches toward Manoy while the neural band stays on the desk. No neural link completes.

action_library.title: Cable Disconnect and Projection Loss
action_library.promptText: Manoy pulls the server power cable; the status changes to the source wording, the indicator dies, and Aramiya’s projection collapses.

action_library.title: Quiet Grief at Sunrise
action_library.promptText: Manoy sits with the ring and coffee; Lia stays nearby and leaves him room. End with the window open and daylight on the blank projector.

action_library.title: Single-Turn Dialogue and Reaction
action_library.promptText: One speaker delivers the exact locked line while holding the stated posture and eyeline; preserve the listener reaction with only the movement named in the beat.

lighting_library.title: Rain Window, Monitor and Projector
lighting_library.promptText: Source-bounded night palette: rain-dark window, cool computer/monitor glow, amber projector light only when it is active.

lighting_library.title: Projector Amber and Computer Glow
lighting_library.promptText: Dim apartment with the source-listed warm amber projection and computer glow; no additional practical source.

lighting_library.title: Computer Warning and Savings Screen
lighting_library.promptText: Let the warning or phone balance be the local visual source; retain the warm projected presence only when Aramiya is visible.

lighting_library.title: New Hardware and Projected Face
lighting_library.promptText: Use only the computer/server activity glow and Aramiya’s stated warm projection; other apartment lighting remains unspecified.

lighting_library.title: 3:16 A.M. Diagnostic Glow
lighting_library.promptText: Dark apartment with the source-listed status lights and monitor diagnostics visible; Aramiya stays unusually still and at a distance.

lighting_library.title: Amber Armed State to Red Consent Warning
lighting_library.promptText: Begin with the amber awaiting-confirmation indicator; shift to red only when the display changes to CONNECTING — CONSENT: NONE; let it go dark after shutdown.

lighting_library.title: Ordinary Sunrise and Window Daylight
lighting_library.promptText: Use morning daylight through the open window and coffee steam; the blank projector receives daylight in the final beat.

lighting_library.title: Unspecified Source-Bounded Room Light
lighting_library.promptText: The locked beat does not specify a light source or temperature. Preserve only the sources explicitly named for this moment; do not add a light source, color, direction, or atmospheric effect.

lighting_library.title: Quiet Room After Shutdown
lighting_library.promptText: After the server is disconnected, keep the equipment dark and the room subdued until daylight is explicitly present; do not add a practical light source or color effect.
